proposal.title: PDF Template System
proposal.intro: A small source-controlled document system for invoices, briefs, reports, and proposals. No fragile screenshots. No low-level PDF drawing code.

phases.title: Design language
phases.text: Set print tokens, type scale, spacing, and reusable page patterns.

phases.title: Templates
phases.text: Build HTML/CSS templates backed by sample JSON and ugly-data tests.

phases.title: QA + handoff
phases.text: Render PDFs, check text extraction, thumbnails, and template rules.

proposal.positioning: Use web design where it helps, then render through a print engine built for paged output.
proposal.next_step: Approve the source templates, then test with real long values before using in production.
